title: The Burning Bush
reflectionQuestion: What do you think Moses felt when God spoke his name?
kidSafetyNotes: DELIBERATE 'Yahweh' covenant-name story -- the doctrine's single-best Yahweh anchor (KID_STORY_PROMPT.md S2: rare+deliberate, story-rule-not-quota, use in Burning Bush). Name given by God himself ('My name is Yahweh'), framed gently as 'God's holy name' (not casual). Fear->reassurance ('I will be with you'). Part of the lane's 'God is with me / not alone' thread. One image: the bush that burns but is not burned up.
